crossRefs.note: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to…
and gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to…
So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to…
These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
translations.bsb: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
translations.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
translations.asv: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.
